title: Every Override Has a Recurring Main Component

citations.verbatim_quote: Conformance: This property can be specified in an iCalendar object containing a recurring calendar component.

A VEVENT (or VTODO) component is a recurrence override if it has the RECURRENCE-ID property set, and the iCalendar object contains a VEVENT (or VTODO) component that does not have the RECURRENCE-ID but the RRULE property set, and the UID property values of the two components are equal. The component without the RECURRENCE-ID property is in that case referred to as the "main component".

statement: Every override (same UID, has RECURRENCE-ID, no RRULE/RDATE) has a main component with the same UID, and that main component is recurring (has RRULE or RDATE).
rationale: RFC 5545 Section 3.8.4.4 allows RECURRENCE-ID only in an iCalendar object containing a recurring calendar component, and draft-ietf-calext-jscalendar-icalendar Section 2.1.2 defines an override relative to a same-UID main component that has RRULE. An override left behind after its series was deleted or made non-recurring is orphaned.
audit_notes: iTIP (RFC 5546) lets an attendee hold only some instances of a series; a store that accepts such partial invitations would need a scoped exception. Not modelled by this spec.
